meta.label: Method
meta.value: Claude reads the platform repo at the named commit (docs/DESIGN.md, docs/RUNBOOK.md, deploy/, charts/, tests/, ci.yml) and scores each axis 0-5 against the same rubric every week. The scores come from the repo, not from the live cluster.

meta.label: Rubric
meta.value: 0 absent · 1 ad hoc · 2 partly in place · 3 in place and tested · 4 enforced and covered by CI · 5 automated, enforced and proven under failure
